title: A Unified Approach to Routing and Cascading for LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2410.10347v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The availability of a wide range of large language models (LLMs) embedded in various agentic systems has significantly increased the potential of model selection strategies to improve the cost-performance tradeoff. Existing strategies involve either routing, where a single model is chosen per query, or cascading, which sequentially runs increasingly larger models until a satisfactory answer is found. However, current approaches face three key limitations: they (1) lack formal proofs of optimality, (2) fail to identify the conditions under which these strategies are most effective to improve the cost-performance tradeoff, and (3) are unable to combine both paradigms for further improvements. translated_title: 大语言模型路由与级联的统一方法
translated_abstract: 嵌入在各种智能体系统中的大量可用大语言模型（LLM）显著提升了模型选择策略改善成本-性能权衡的潜力。现有策略要么采用路由，即为每个查询选择单个模型；要么采用级联，即依次运行越来越大的模型直到找到满意的答案。然而，当前方法面临三个关键限制：（1）缺乏最优性的形式化证明，（2）未能确定这些策略在何种条件下最有效地改善成本-性能权衡，（3）无法将两种范式结合以获得进一步改进。为解决这些问题，我们首先推导出一种新颖的最优级联策略，并证明了现有路由策略的最优性。此外，我们提出了级联路由——一个将路由和级联整合到统一理论框架中的方法。
tldr: 本文提出“级联路由”这一统一理论框架，将路由与级联两种模型选择范式相结合，推导出了最优级联策略并证明了现有路由策略的最优性，从而有效改善大语言模型选择的成本-性能权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes cascade routing, a unified theoretical framework that integrates routing and cascading paradigms for LLM selection, deriving a novel optimal cascading strategy and proving the optimality of an existing routing strategy to improve the cost-performance tradeoff.
